title: Task Decomposition, Contextual Memory & Ear Core Tuning
summary: This update introduces recursive task decomposition for complex queries, significantly improves conversational context retention across LLMs, and refines the auditory input sensitivity for more natural interaction.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Added task_decomposer.py to break down complex, multi-part user queries into atomic, standalone prompts compatible with the Intent Router.
Introduced a recursive execution loop within visar_edge_brain to process the Decomposer_queue sequentially until all sub-tasks are resolved.
Added a Windows system beep as an immediate auditory cue when the microphone activates.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Upgraded Chat Core to inject full conversation history, System Instructions, Recent Chat Summaries, and Long-term Memory into requests.
Refactored Gemini and Groq API payloads to process historical context and system prompts, significantly increasing response reliability and conversational coherence.
Reduced the Ear Core energy_threshold, allowing the system to accurately detect and process quieter, softer speech commands.
Increased the Ear Core pause_threshold to 1.2s to accommodate natural pauses in user speech without cutting off input prematurely.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Patched the listening_started signal to emit strictly only when the listener loop is confirmed to be active.

notes: Version 1.1.4.0 dramatically enhances VISAR's cognitive processing by allowing it to autonomously break down multi-step instructions. Combined with the new context-injection pipeline for Groq and Gemini, the AI now maintains strong conversational continuity.
